thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx/timeouts on /v1/generate (p95 5s -> 18s, p99 22s) — error-rate 5.6% across us-west-2 and eu-west-1

DeployBot: Deployment completed: release/2026-03-15-hotpath-optimizations by maya at 2061122320

Raj (oncall): seeing timeouts and connection resets from edge -> runtime, started paging. Anyone still on the deploy?

Maya (runtime): I kicked the rollout at ~2061122320. Early telemetry looked fine for small payloads. Pulling logs now.

Emma (sre): Confirmed alerts. 1 customer reporting increased 502s. Spike started ~2m after deploy.

Raj (oncall): quick impact check: which routes? is it only streaming/generation?

Maya (runtime): Hotpath /v1/generate batch size > 1 and streaming enabled. Non-streaming single-token calls mostly okay. Looks like KV cache eviction went up.

CS-Beta: a handful of beta customers saw 504s, one did emergency fallback to smaller model.

Raj (oncall): ok, run quick smoke curl against the endpoint from us-west-2 and from inside runtime node\n
Maya (runtime): Running now:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -d '{"model":"hotpath-v2","prompt":"hi","max_tokens":512}' -o /tmp/out
# us-west-2: total time 19.8s, HTTP/1.1 504
# on-runtime-node: total time 21.3s, connection reset
```

Emma (sre): stack traces show a long wait in the attention kernel for sequences > 1024, then a timeout at the proxy layer. p99 token latency huge.

Maya (runtime): I see burst of `kv-cache-miss` and `kv-evict` events coincident with the spike. The hotpath optimizations changed memory layout of KV cache to favor locality, maybe a regression under concurrent multiplexing.

Raj (oncall): Route traffic to fallback pool (older model variant /hotpath-v1) while we triage? Can we switch only affected customers?

Maya (runtime): Manual routing: switching traffic policy now for prod-tenants -> fallback pool. Executing:`redwood route update --selector=prod-tenants --to-model=hotpath-v1 --force`

DeployBot: Traffic policy change submitted by maya at 2061122365 — routing shift in progress

Emma (sre): Monitor error-rate and token-latency after the switch.

(2m later)

CS-Beta: errors dropped to 0.6% for affected customers. Thanks.

Maya (runtime): Routing rollback reduced impact but there are still intermittent timeouts for public traffic. Suggest full rollback of the release and re-deploy after root cause.

Raj (oncall): Agree. We need a fast safe rollback. Maya, can you trigger rollback to release/2026-03-10-hotpath-stable?

Maya (runtime): Rolling back now. `deploy rollback --to release/2026-03-10-hotpath-stable`

DeployBot: Rollback initiated by maya at 2061122390. Estimated completion ~60s.

IncidentBot: Paging update: Priority 1 incident — Timeout regression after deploy. Pager duty: Raj -> Leo (next) for handoff after mitigation.

Emma (sre): Post-rollback, I'm seeing p95 down to 1.4s and p99 ~2.1s across regions. Error-rate back to baseline 0.3%.

Raj (oncall): Good. Hold the channel. We need to capture artifacts for postmortem: traces, kernel logs, memory layout diffs, and the rollout manifest.

Maya (runtime): Dumping runtime telemetry to s3://incidents/2061122334/ forroot cause. Key files:
- kernel-profiles.tar.gz
- kvcache-metrics.json
- rollout-manifest.yml

Raj (oncall): Assigning follow-ups:
- Maya => root cause investigation (kv cache layout vs multiplexing)
- Emma => validate rollback perf across all regions and customer scopes
- Leo => own next-day oncall and coordinate customer comms if needed

Leo (night-oncall): I'll take handoff in 30m, will review artifacts and start an RCA doc. ping me if anything regresses.

CS-Beta: any ETA for customer-facing note? we need to tell the few impacted customers we rolled back and are investigating.

Raj (oncall): Maya/Emma, can you provide a succinct note for CS? include: time window, affected endpoints, mitigations (routing rollback + full rollback), customer impact (percent requests failed), and next steps.

Maya (runtime): Draft note: "We detected elevated timeouts on /v1/generate after a deploy at 20:32 UTC. We rolled back the release at 20:39 UTC. Impact: ~5% of requests for a small subset of customers experienced 5xx/timeout errors for ~7 minutes. Mitigation: traffic routing to fallback pool and full rollback. Next steps: root cause investigation into KV cache layout change under concurrent multiplex workloads."

Emma (sre): I'll add perf numbers and confirm region list.

Raj (oncall): Good. Closing mitigation items for now. We will keep channel open for RCA updates. If anyone sees a re-spike -> @oncall escalate. :thumbsup: 

(End of thread)
